answer_2.quote: We also propose a novel metric CONS-R-L that leverages the structure of CAVE's rationales to measure consistency between a rationale and its task (AV) label.

answer_4.quote: We pick 50 document pairs per dataset (total of 150 pairs) and evaluate the rationales generated by their corresponding CAVE. ... We analyze the strengths & weaknesses of CAVE's rationales, which help to understand the utility of these rationales to downstream applications.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to comment on why a rationale is unsatisfactory and to assess each rationale on specific properties.
